jobs.name: Dia inteiro
jobs.story: Ao fim de um longo dia, Folha descansa aberto sobre uma almofada, entre a luz do sol e a noite.
jobs.scene: A peaceful study room after a whole day of work, with SUNSET in a left arched window and MOON/STARS in a right arched window. Folha is a medium-sized fully OPEN book reclining diagonally on a plush indigo cushion on a desk, shown from a gentle LOW THREE-QUARTER FRONT angle, both broad inner page planes and the center crease visible. The entire book tilts back coherently, not folding shut; no back-cover panels face camera. Sleepy softly closed eyes, relieved small smile, cap tilted slightly. Keep both arm roots at the actual left and right SIDES of the book despite its tilt. His LEFT short arm supports a tiny closed study notebook beside the left cover; his RIGHT short arm rests its cream hand on the cushion beside the right cover. Both hands stay OUTSIDE their corresponding book edges, clearly connected, no self-hugging arms or any limb crossing the pages. A beautiful small sapphire hourglass and quill rest on the desk at left, with warm-to-cool light crossing the room. Book body, cushion and props feel soft, tactile and restful. No face between nearly closed covers, no face on the paper thickness and no dangling arms.
jobs.prompt:
Create ONE entirely NEW Estudário achievement painting from scratch. Reference image 1 is the EXACT FIXED TIER FRAME: preserve its outline, scale, thickness, wreath, crest, gemstones and empty indigo fabric ribbon; paint the scene only in its central opening. Reference image 2 is ONLY the approved Folha identity and collection style, never a pose to copy. Rich dip-pen ink, layered gouache and colored-pencil grain, beautifully controlled warm storytelling light, nuanced pigment and hand-painted edges, polished editorial illustration that reads at 512 px, not plastic 3D or a flat app icon.

FOLHA CONSTRUCTION: a real open indigo hardcover BOOK, two broad gently CURVED cream inner page surfaces with a clear center crease, thin fanned paper edges, small indigo graduation cap and a mint bookmark. Friendly expressive face ON THE INNER PAGES; one eye on each page plane. Maintain a coherent dimensional book with curved leaf corners, not a square box, tablet, suitcase, human torso or face on paper thickness. Exactly TWO SHORT indigo arms of similar proportional length (about one fifth of the book's width), one from each OUTER LATERAL hardcover edge at MID-HEIGHT. Each root is hidden just behind that cover edge; each exposed forearm goes directly to one cream mitten hand. Exactly TWO hands, visibly connected to their two arms. Bring props close rather than stretching arms. No arm from the cap, top, bottom, spine or broad page/cover face; no extra limb, long ribbon arm, loop around the body or detached glove. Folha floats when moving: NO LEGS, FEET, SHOES or human lower body. Keep character and props entirely within the frame opening. Real transparent exterior, ribbon completely EMPTY. No words, letters, numbers, fake text, logos or watermarks anywhere. One complete square badge, no sheet.

jobs.name: Primeiro dia
jobs.story: Folha celebra a primeira meta cumprida com uma pequena bandeira ao lado do plano do dia.
jobs.scene: The first daily goal has just been completed. An intimate sunrise-lit wooden study desk, a SINGLE cream daily-plan card bearing a simple mint CHECK, and a small cairn of neatly folded papers with a SHORT mint-and-indigo flag planted beside it. Folha floats UPRIGHT near the cairn at center-right, in a balanced THREE-QUARTER LEFT view, slightly leaning toward the little flag. The open book has natural tall curved page leaves and a clearly visible center crease, with a slim indigo cover around the back; avoid a wide squat rectangle, square cardboard block or rigid flat slab. His LEFT short lateral arm holds the nearby short flag pole at mid-body height, his RIGHT short lateral arm opens its palm beside the opposite cover in a gentle proud gesture. Two small cream hands, both close to the two sides of the book, never above the cap or below its bottom. Kind proud smile, bright relaxed eyes, no scowl. Delicate morning dust, ink bottle, a modest stack of books and a window frame add a professional painted atmosphere. The bronze scene is intimate and elegant, its sense of achievement conveyed through light and craft rather than an oversized heroic pose.

jobs.name: Cinco mil
jobs.story: Um arquivo de cartões respondidos se transforma numa grande biblioteca de treino.
jobs.scene: A grand warm study library filled with beautifully organized cabinets of answered question cards. A gentle LOW-ANGLE THREE-QUARTER FRONT view of Folha floating at center-left, proudly examining a SMALL cream question folio held CLOSE with BOTH hands in front of the lower book. Folha's two broad cream inner page planes and central gutter are completely coherent; both eyes and a small friendly proud smile are clear and undistorted, with no face slipping onto an edge or spine. The LEFT short arm comes directly from the outer left side to the folio's left corner; the RIGHT short arm comes directly from the outer right side to its right corner. Both arm routes and both mittens remain visible; the small folio may cover only the lower page margin, never the eyes or mouth. His cap and mint bookmark sit naturally. Surround him with five neat modest stacks of answered cards, drawers with simple star/check pictograms, and tall softly glowing shelves that recede in perspective. No ladder, no hanging pose, no rear-cover body facing camera, no huge trophy. The storytelling is mastery through thoughtful practice, with sapphire glints, crisp ink and rich gouache texture.

jobs.name: Memória de elefante
jobs.story: Um único elefante gentil recebe um cartão de revisão apresentado pelo Folha.
jobs.scene: An enchanting library conservatory with leaves, tiny cream flowers and golden window light. A SMALL GENTLE LAVENDER ELEPHANT stands at the LEFT in clear SIDE PROFILE facing RIGHT, with a coherent complete body, four natural legs on the ground, two ears with the far one partly occluded, one tail, NO TUSKS. The elephant has EXACTLY ONE TRUNK: ONE continuous anatomically natural tube starting at the CENTER OF ITS NOSE, curving gently down then lifting a little at its SINGLE tip toward a nearby leaf card. There is NO SECOND TRUNK emerging from cheek, mouth, chin or body; no split tip, duplicate face, extra hose, long tail in front, trunk cradle or trunk under Folha. Keep its single trunk silhouette very clear against the background. Folha floats to the RIGHT of the elephant, at a comfortable conversational distance, facing it in THREE-QUARTER LEFT view. Folha is a real OPEN book with two broad cream page planes, cap and mint bookmark, amused affectionate smile. Both SHORT lateral indigo arms hold ONE small cream card with a mint leaf pictogram close in front, one cream mitten on either edge. The elephant gently reaches toward the card with its one trunk. Neither character wraps around or supports the other. Beautiful emerald foliage and warm painted depth, with clear separate silhouettes for the elephant's trunk and Folha's two arms.

jobs.name: Um ano inteiro
jobs.story: Folha celebra um ano de constância em um jardim que reúne as quatro estações.
jobs.scene: A radiant four-season library garden celebrates a full year of consistency: spring pink blossoms at upper-left, summer sunflowers and golden light at upper-right, autumn amber leaves at lower-left, winter blue-white snowflakes at lower-right. Folha floats UPRIGHT at the CENTER in a near-front THREE-QUARTER view, with a slight joyful tilt of ONLY a few degrees, not sideways or upside down. Graduation cap clearly on TOP, lower cover clearly at BOTTOM, two broad cream inner page faces and gutter. Bright delighted eyes with a playful wink, gentle open smile. TWO SHORT indigo arms emerge HORIZONTALLY from the LEFT and RIGHT OUTER COVER SIDES at the SAME MID-HEIGHT. The left small cream palm catches a single autumn leaf beside the left side, the right small cream palm receives a snowflake beside the right side. Both hands stay level with the lower cheeks, OUTSIDE the sides, NEVER above the cap or below the book. Keep both roots hidden by their lateral cover edges. The mint bookmark is short and drapes down a page; it must not trail around the body like another arm. No arms on upper/lower corners, no figure spinning around. Delicate gold light and seasonal petals give the highest-rank scene grandeur. Preserve every part of the annual emerald/gold frame exactly as reference 1.

jobs.name: Cinquenta tópicos
jobs.story: Folha organiza dois pequenos livros de assuntos estudados numa biblioteca acolhedora.
jobs.scene: A cozy sunlit library desk seen at a gentle THREE-QUARTER angle. Folha floats upright at center-right, turning slightly LEFT toward a low shelf, smiling with quiet satisfaction. He carries only TWO SMALL CLOSED STUDY BOOKS held CLOSE in front of his lower cover, not an enormous pile. Their total width is at most two-thirds of Folha's own open-book width and their total height no more than one-quarter of his height, leaving his complete inner-page face clearly visible. One short indigo arm from the LEFT outer side leads directly to the LEFT cream mitten supporting the left end of the little book stack; the other equally short arm from the RIGHT outer side leads directly to the RIGHT cream mitten supporting the right end. Both arm lengths are balanced, roughly one fifth of Folha's width, with small mitten hands; no long reach around books, tiny body with giant limbs, hidden glove or books covering the face. Folha has two softly curved broad cream page planes and a center gutter, indigo hardcover perimeter, cap and mint bookmark. A few orderly books on the shelf, a small green check card on the desk and a warm window complete the calm elegant scene. Make the proportions physically convincing and the painting detailed without clutter.
